notes.en:
## Summary and General Analysis
- Kafka is a DoT support capable of detonating DoTs outside of enemy turns.
- When Kafka attacks enemies with her Ultimate, Skill, and Follow-Up ATKs, DoTs on the enemies trigger for a portion of their damage.
- Kafka gains one Follow-Up ATK charge after using her Ultimate and after her turn ends. 
- Kafka's performance is heavily reliant on Hysilens for DoT damage.

## Investment Priority
 ### Hysilens E1 > Kafka E1
- Hysilens' E1 is DoT's best early investment, providing a unique 16% DMG Boost while doubling the number of DoTs she applies (4 -> 8). This Eidolon not only greatly increases Hysilens' personal damage (especially in double DoT teams), it also greatly increases Black Swan's personal damage.
- E1 provides 30% DoT Vulnerability.
